title: Finite free module sheaves have projective open-site stalks
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq Y$ open, $y\in U$, and $m\in\mathbb N$. The image under $S_{U,y}$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor] of the rank-$m$ free sheaf of modules on the slice site over $U$ is a projective module over $\mathcal O_{Y,j(y)}$, where $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ is the inclusion. Projective means that every morphism from this module to the target of a surjective module map lifts through that map.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves Tag 08C4, stalk argument step 2; Modules Tag 01AG

proof.text: Mathlib overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso carries the unit on the slice site to the unit on the open subscheme. Apply the stalk-unit isomorphism. The open immersion stalk ring map is an isomorphism, so ModuleCat.restrictScalarsIsoOfEquiv identifies the restricted regular module with the original regular module; this module is projective. Extract the unit-stalk isomorphism from Scheme.ideal_module_product_stalk applied to the identity inclusion of the unit sheaf and the unit coefficient sheaf.

The rank-m free sheaf is the coproduct indexed by ULift(Fin m) of the unit sheaf. Exactness of the explicit stalk functor preserves this finite coproduct, including m=0. PreservesCoproduct.iso identifies its image with a coproduct of projective unit stalks. Coproducts of projectives are projective; transport this property through the isomorphism. Extract the unit-stalk isomorphism from Scheme.ideal_module_product_stalk applied to the identity inclusion of the unit sheaf and the unit coefficient sheaf.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01AG and the stalk constructions; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01AG

Mathlib Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv and restrictStalkNatIso identify the sites and underlying abelian stalks. No public module-linear open-site natural comparison is stated. The source library supplies overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso. The public Scheme.ideal_module_product_stalk supplies the unit-stalk isomorphism by taking the identity inclusion and unit coefficient sheaf; no duplicate unit-stalk declaration is added. The public nonempty_restriction_stalk_extension_iso in Modules.RestrictionStalkExtensionIso supplies the coefficient isomorphism by applying it to a single complex, evaluating at zero, and cancelling scalars through the adjunction unit; no private helper is duplicated.

lean.statement:
theorem openModuleStalk_free_projective
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) (y : U.toScheme) (m : ℕ) :
    Projective ((openModuleStalkFunctor Y U y).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m))))
